title: Farm Real Estate Loans — Lending Schedule of Loan Amounts, Loan-to-Value Limits and Entry Requirements
content:
**Product:** Farm Real Estate Loans (the six FarmLand mortgage products) · **Subject:** how large a loan may be and what each product requires at entry

The size of a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage is bounded three ways, each set per product:

- **Smallest original principal** — the smallest original principal of the loan, in USD.
- **Largest original principal** — the largest original principal of the loan, in USD.
- **Largest loan-to-value by land use** — the largest principal as a percentage of appraised value, by the land use of the parcels mortgaged; a loan on mixed parcels uses the value-weighted average of the parcel limits.

A fourth figure decides the valuation that supports the loan: the **appraisal threshold** is the loan amount above which a full appraisal by a state-certified appraiser is required instead of an evaluation, in USD.

## Schedule 1 — Loan amounts and valuation

| Product | Smallest original principal (USD) | Largest original principal (USD) | Full appraisal required above (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage | 50000 | 5000000 | 250000 |
| FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 75000 | 7500000 | 250000 |
| FarmLand 5-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 75000 | 10000000 | 250000 |
| FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 100000 | 10000000 | 250000 |
| FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 100000 | 7500000 | 250000 |
| FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage | 100000 | 5000000 | 250000 |

## Schedule 2 — Largest principal as a percentage of appraised value, by land use

| Product | Irrigated cropland | Dryland cropland | Pasture | Recreational | Farmstead |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage | 75 | 75 | 70 | 60 | 75 |
| FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 75 | 75 | 70 | 60 | 75 |
| FarmLand 5-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 75 | 75 | 70 | 60 | 75 |
| FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 70 | 70 | 65 | 55 | 70 |
| FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 70 | 70 | 65 | 55 | 70 |
| FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage | 65 | 65 | 60 | 50 | 65 |

## Schedule 3 — Entry requirements by product

| Product | First lien required | Appraisal or evaluation | Other entry requirement |
|---|---|---|---|
| FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage | yes | yes | minimum years farming: 0 |
| FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage | yes | yes | minimum years farming: 0 |
| FarmLand 5-Year Adjustable Mortgage | yes | yes | minimum years farming: 0 |
| FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage | yes | yes | minimum debt service coverage: 1.2 |
| FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | yes | yes | minimum debt service coverage: 1.25 |
| FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage | yes | yes | minimum debt service coverage: 1.3; minimum loan: USD 100000 |

## Notes on reading the schedules

**The appraisal threshold is a strict "above".** An amount of exactly USD 250000 is supported by an evaluation; any amount above USD 250000 needs a full appraisal by a state-certified appraiser.

**Mixed parcels (hypothetical illustration).** Suppose a loan under the FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage is to be secured by irrigated cropland appraised at USD 600000 and pasture appraised at USD 400000. The parcel limits are 75 percent and 70 percent. Weighted by value, the average limit is 75 percent for six tenths of the value and 70 percent for four tenths, which comes to 73 percent; applied to the combined appraised value of USD 1000000, the largest principal is USD 730000.00, provided it also lies within the product's smallest and largest original principal. The figures in this illustration are example inputs, not company facts.

**Comparing products.** The three shorter-fixed products (the variable-rate mortgage and the 3-Year and 5-Year adjustable mortgages) share one land-use ladder; the 10-Year Adjustable and 15-Year Fixed mortgages lend five points less on every land use; the 25-Year Fixed Mortgage lends ten points less than the first group.
